findings.issue_text: services/src/main/java/org/keycloak/authentication/authenticators/browser/UsernamePasswordForm.java:160 — [P1, confidence 100] `return webauthnAuth != null && webauthnAuth.isPasskeysEnabled() && user != null;` inverts the pre-change user-state gate, so every initial username/password authentication has a null user and never receives the conditional-UI challenge or attributes, removing passkey login from the normal first-login form.

services/src/main/java/org/keycloak/authentication/authenticators/browser/UsernamePasswordForm.java:115 — [P1, confidence 100] `if (isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(context.getUser()))` rejects every initial unauthenticated login, so `webauthnAuth.fillContextForm(context)` never enables the passkey UI and discoverable/external-key passkey sign-in no longer works before a username is selected.

services/src/main/java/org/keycloak/authentication/authenticators/browser/UsernameForm.java:47 — [P1; confidence 100] `if (context.getUser() != null && !isConditionalPasskeysEnabled())` invokes a no-argument method that does not exist (the inherited method requires `UserModel`), so the services module fails Java compilation and the change cannot be built or run.

services/src/main/java/org/keycloak/authentication/authenticators/browser/WebAuthnConditionalUIAuthenticator.java:53 — [P2, confidence 75] The added `AuthenticatorUtils.setupReauthenticationInUsernamePasswordFormError(context);` error-path behavior has no test that causes a passkey failure during `prompt=login`, so a regression that reveals the username or registration controls after a failed conditional-passkey re-authentication remains green.

goldens.comment: In UsernameForm.authenticate(), isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() is called without passing the required UserModel parameter.

With isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel user) requiring user != null, authenticate(...) will not call webauthnAuth.fillContextForm(context) on the initial login page where context.getUser() is still null, so conditional passkey UI will not be set up for first-time passkey login. Consider whether this should also be enabled when no user has been selected yet so ID-less passkey authentication on the initial login form continues to work.

adjudication_records.issue_text: services/src/main/java/org/keycloak/authentication/authenticators/browser/WebAuthnConditionalUIAuthenticator.java:53 — [P2, confidence 75] The added `AuthenticatorUtils.setupReauthenticationInUsernamePasswordFormError(context);` error-path behavior has no test that causes a passkey failure during `prompt=login`, so a regression that reveals the username or registration controls after a failed conditional-passkey re-authentication remains green.

adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies that the new code path `AuthenticatorUtils.setupReauthenticationInUsernamePasswordFormError(context)` added in WebAuthnConditionalUIAuthenticator.java line 53 is called during passkey error handling, but the new tests (webauthnLoginWithDiscoverableKey_reauthentication, webauthnLoginWithExternalKey_reauthentication, etc.) only test successful passkey re-authentication scenarios. None of the tests verify the error path where a passkey fails during re-authentication with prompt=login, which would exercise this new setupReauthenticationInUsernamePasswordFormError call. This is a legitimate missing test coverage concern for newly added error-handling logic.
